name: 8-puzzle, five moves from the goal
note: Start 2 8 3 / 1 6 4 / 7 _ 5, goal 1 2 3 / 8 _ 4 / 7 6 5. The shortest solution is 5 moves. BFS expands 35 states, A* only 6 with either heuristic: they tie on this easy board (try space-8-puzzle-12 to see Manhattan clearly beat tiles out of place). DFS does not find the goal within the 400-expansion cap.
